title: Elevate primary coastal roads by 1m
description: Keeps evacuation corridors and emergency supply routes open after storm surge events.
benefit_tags: Protects evacuation time | Unblocks ambulance access

title: Reinforce hospital roofs and backup power
description: Hardens emergency departments, reduces outages, and keeps critical care online during storms.

title: Build and retrofit community shelters
description: Adds resilient shelter beds in high exposure communities with backup communications.
benefit_tags: Protects vulnerable residents | Improves emergency readiness

title: Restore mangroves and living shorelines
description: Uses nature-based buffers to damp storm surge and reduce chronic coastal erosion.

title: Upgrade drainage and pump stations
description: Reduces urban flash flooding around dense communities and industrial estates.
benefit_tags: Fast visible wins | Cuts repeat flood damage

title: Install solar microgrids for emergency assets
description: Adds distributed backup power to clinics, shelters, and EOC facilities.
benefit_tags: Energy resilience | Supports continuity of operations

title: Relocate highly exposed households inland
description: Moves the most repeatedly flooded households out of surge zones and river mouths.
